integrity: The exact facet presentation is independently replayed. All three-vertex cliques, all nonfacial triangular homology classes, all 46,080 pair-preserving candidate symmetries, and all carrier orbits are exhaustively checked. The integral H1 identification uses the published topology RP3 and the universal coefficient theorem. An older exact census is bibliographically resolved only to the year 1999, so no artificial day is assigned; the recorded date is the earliest day-resolved exact-object source inspected.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the twelve-vertex vertex-transitive 24-cell quotient triangulation of RP3 and to combinatorial unit-edge simple cycles. It does not classify longer representatives or metric geodesics.
title: Four symmetry types of triangular torsion systoles in the twelve-vertex \(24\)-cell quotient \(\mathbb{RP}^3\)
